text.p: As flood cleanup continues along the Oder River and in Poland in northeastern Europe, drier weather during the next couple days will be more favorable.
In Japan, cleanup will continue in the south after the heavy rains and flooding caused by Rosie. Drier weather by Saturday will be favorable for cleanup efforts.

Monsoonal moisture has been causing heavy thunderstorms in the mountains of east central Colorado. Major flooding occurred near Fort Collins early this week. Additional storms the past couple of days are resulting in rivers and streams rising to near flood levels. Additional flooding is expected over the next couple days as the chance of thunderstorms persists.

Tropical Storm Victor is in the South China Sea, moving slowly northwestward, and is expected to turn more to the north then north northeast. Victor has 50 mph winds but may strengthen to a minimal typhoon before expected landfall near Hong Kong on Saturday. This system brings the threat of wind damage, heavy rain, and flooding to the region.
